Codex Context Window v0.3.0 helps the model actively account for approaching context compaction instead of only showing token usage.

At the beginning of every session, the plugin now provides a conservative default policy: from 70% reported usage onward, the model should keep compaction in mind throughout its continuing work and make sure the information needed to proceed remains available. The policy does not prescribe whether or how to save anything, and applicable instructions in `AGENTS.md` or the Codex system instructions can define different behavior.

After compaction, the plugin verifies that the information needed to continue is still available and restores the same context-window guidance that may have disappeared from the previous context.

## What changed

- **Continuous preparation from 70%** — the threshold now starts an ongoing mode of attention rather than suggesting a one-time checkpoint.
- **User-controlled preservation policy** — the model may choose how to protect intermediate state, while project or system instructions can specify whether to use files and what, where, and how to save.
- **Complete post-compaction guidance** — `SessionStart(compact)` reads the effective context-window limit from the current session and repeats the same policy used at startup.
- **Safe compact fallback** — if the limit is unavailable, the hook still reports that compaction occurred without inventing a value.
- **Consistent main-agent and subagent behavior** — `SessionStart(startup)` and `SubagentStart` share the same guidance.
- **Updated English and Russian documentation** — both READMEs show the exact injected messages and explain the default policy.

The regular `UserPromptSubmit` and `PostToolUse` usage signals are unchanged.

## Upgrade

Refresh the marketplace and reinstall the plugin:

```bash
codex plugin marketplace upgrade codex-context-window
codex plugin add codex-context-window@codex-context-window
```

Then open a new chat or restart Codex so the updated hooks are loaded.

## Compatibility

This release has no breaking configuration changes and supports the same macOS, Linux, and Windows targets as v0.2.1.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/nleononline/codex-context-window/compare/v0.2.1...v0.3.0
